assumptions: Anchor is center because boxes are top-down vehicles whose centre is metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not ground contact.
Stop-sign presence cannot be seen; every tracked vehicle in the approach is treated as subject to the stop-sign rule.

Limit line is assumed marked in this deployment (stop_line/stop_zone provided), so the 'otherwise before entering the crosswalk' and 'if there is no limit line or crosswalk' branches are out of scope and not checked.
Approaching is interpreted as inbound (+y) motion, encoded as to_right per line geometry.
Statute specifies stop without duration; 1000 ms continuous stopped dwell is required as minimum observable stop.
Stop must occur in stop_zone (last 10 m before line) to count as 'at' the limit line.
Objects that never cross the stop line inbound pass; only the first inbound crossing is checked for a preceding stop.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Every vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first stopped continuously in the approach waiting zone before crossing.

text:
The driver of any vehicle approaching a stop sign at the entrance to, or within, an intersection shall stop at a limit line, if marked, otherwise before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection.

If there is no limit line or crosswalk, the driver shall stop at the entrance to the intersecting roadway.
